title: Day Zero Tulum 2027 Announces Lineup: See Who’s Playing
summary: Damian Lazarus' annual jungle boogie returns on Jan. 9.
contentText:
The lineup for Damian Lazarus’ annual turn-of-the-year party in Tulum, Day Zero, was announced Thursday (Aug. 13).

The bill features scene mainstays including Tiga, Victor Calderone, Vintage Culture, LP Giobbi, Chloé Caillet and Mita Gami, along with a flurry of buzzy rising artists like Brunello and Midnight Generation in addition to Lazarus himself. Organizers also promise one “very special guest” whose identity is yet to be announced. See the complete lineup below.

Lazarus, who’s been putting on Day Zero in the jungle near Tulum since 2012, posted the lineup to his Instagram with a caption noting that “Another chapter of cosmic celebration is upon us for a night under the stars where mysticism and music converge. The curation is uncompromising. 30 artists spanning the full spectrum of underground electronic sound across 3 stages. Boundary-pushing performances from the most visionary minds carefully selected for this singular gathering. And one very special guest still emerging from the shadows. If you felt the magic last year, this edition raises it further.”

Day Zero Tulum 2027 happens in the Mexican resort town on January 9 and is the thirteenth edition of the party, which embraces the traditions of the local Mayan culture and goes from sunset until Lazarus’ traditional sunrise set. Tickets go on sale Aug. 25.

Day Zero hosted its debut Bali edition this past April, with the first edition in Brazil taking place this past January. An Israel edition of Day Zero happened near the Dead Sea in 2019.
